bug_semantics: CVE-2025-71346 is a downstream packaging of libxml2 CVE-2025-32415. Nokogiri CRuby vendors libxml2 and exposes XML Schema validation (Nokogiri::XML::Schema → xmlSchemaParse / xmlSchemaValidateDoc / xmlSchemaValidateFile). In libxml2 before 2.13.8 (and 2.14.0–2.14.1), xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables in xmlschemas.c copies bind->nbNodes into a local nbNodeTable and later iterates with that stale count after the identity-constraint node table can shrink, causing a heap buffer under-read (CWE-125). The path is reachable when validating an untrusted XSD, or when validating an untrusted document against a trusted schema that uses xsd:keyref together with recursively defined types that have additional identity constraints. Upstream/MITRE rate it 2.9 LOW; impact is availability (crash/DoS), not a Nokogiri-authored memory bug. JRuby is off this libxml2 path; CRuby built against a patched system libxml2 is also unaffected.
flaw_origin: The flawed lines live in upstream libxml2 (Nick Wellnhofer fix 384cc7c1 / 487ee1d8: replace stale nbNodeTable with bind->nbNodes). They are not present in the Nokogiri git tree: libxml2 is a build-time tarball pinned in dependencies.yml, and patches/libxml2 does not touch xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables. Nokogiri first wrote packaging of a vulnerable libxml2 in 131df0d6bf14a26f31c35f62de0d6b44f0328526 (2008-10-15), which downloaded libxml2-2.7.1.win32 for Windows cross gems; parent 93761f9965b827fbf6585ee67fe50da75678a74c has no zlatkovic/libxml2-2.7 packaging. Schema validation was added later in 469d5283f04122fe9c6459af7041394a34f0f3c6 (2009-03-27). Default non-Windows vendoring (mini_portile / dependencies.yml) is a 2013 refactor (4ded299a / b79a4fe7 / efac85f6), not a first-write. Every packaged pin through v1.18.7 (libxml2 2.13.7) remained vulnerable until 6457fe639359edda9f8817994bc4935abae3e81e bumped the pin to 2.13.8.

evidence: CVE.org CVE-2025-71346 state=PUBLISHED (CNA VulnCheck, datePublished 2026-08-25, not rejected/withdrawn). GHSA-2ph4-3vr8-f2m3 withdrawn_at=null. Vendor GHSA-5w6v-399v-w3cc (flavorjones, 2025-04-21) is the first-party advisory: Nokogiri < 1.18.8 affected, 1.18.8 patched; CRuby vendored libxml2 2.13.8 addresses CVE-2025-32415 (CVE-2025-32414 Python-only, no Nokogiri impact).

Upstream mechanism: GitLab GNOME/libxml2#890 and commit 384cc7c182fc00c6d5e2ab4b5e3671b2e3f93c84 / 487ee1d8 change xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables from if (nbNodeTable) / while (j < nbNodeTable) to bind->nbNodes because the local can be stale. Maintainer: affects all libxml2 older than 2.13.8 / 2.14.2. CVE-2025-32415: libxml2 from 0 before 2.13.8 and 2.14.0 before 2.14.2.

Nokogiri attack path (not the memory bug): 469d5283f04122fe9c6459af7041394a34f0f3c6 added ext/nokogiri/xml_schema.c calling xmlSchemaParse + xmlSchemaValidateDoc; parent 01d355faf014f1d0fae6cd42f6bfd6e3d42f7a4b lacks xml_schema.c. At v1.18.7 the same APIs remain (xmlSchemaValidateDoc line 46, xmlSchemaValidateFile line 85). git grep xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables / nbNodeTable at v1.18.7 over patches/ and ext/ is empty — the buggy function is only inside the vendored tarball.

BIC (first packaging of a vulnerable libxml2, walking through later mini_portile/dependencies.yml refactors): 131df0d6bf14a26f31c35f62de0d6b44f0328526 'adding tasks to build cross compiled nokogiri' added Rakefile libs including libxml2-2.7.1.win32 downloaded from http://www.zlatkovic.com/pub/libxml/ (file lines ~122–135). Single parent 93761f9965b827fbf6585ee67fe50da75678a74c; git grep zlatkovic|libxml2-2.7 on that parent tree is empty. Not a merge/squash. Ancestor of REL_1.0.0 and of v1.18.7 (13e8aa4ef52f39d1273d2435bd6bfa98982471ef).

Later packaging is expansion/refactor, not first-write: 7cb54b23b2a46f07af56c1ed11fa3a2f5076d6a3 (2010) moved Windows builds to compiling libxml2-2.7.7 from source; 4ded299a740612b87b8cc576efdb998f5a733192 + b79a4fe71948b4326e1aa92ffe63e6dfde7b6d3b (2013) made mini_portile fat-source the CRuby default (in v1.6.0); efac85f638b81aa4dbdec95b36e7d60ab6e09392 introduced dependencies.yml. All of those commits are Mike Dalessio / Aaron Patterson with no AI trailers.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2025-71346 restates the vendor GHSA that Nokogiri CRuby ships libxml2 containing CVE-2025-32415. The memory bug is a stale local in libxml2 xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables (heap under-read while filling identity-constraint node tables). Nokogiri's own xml_schema.c is a thin, correct wrapper around xmlSchemaValidate*; it does not implement IDC tables. CVE.org lists CVE-2025-71346 as PUBLISHED (not rejected), and GHSA-5w6v-399v-w3cc is an unwithdrawn vendor advisory, so this is a real packaging vulnerability rather than FALSE_POSITIVE. BIC search started from the packaged libxml2 pin the fix changes, then walked through mini_portile/dependencies.yml refactors and the 2010 source-build rewrite to the first commit that actually introduced redistribution of a libxml2 that includes the buggy schema IDC code: 131df0d6 (Windows zlatkovic libxml2-2.7.1.win32). Parent-tree grep shows that packaging is absent immediately before that commit. Upstream stated the libxml2 bug affects all versions before 2.13.8, so 2.7.1 is in range. Schema support (469d5283) is the later attack-path addition, not the first-write of the packaged vulnerable library; treating it as BIC would invert the packaging CVE. Tag check: BIC is in REL_1.0.0 and v1.18.7 (affected < 1.18.8); the 2.13.8 pin is a child of v1.18.7 and is contained in v1.18.8, matching the patched boundary. AI is judged only on the BIC object: 2008 Aaron Patterson, no AI authorship/co-authorship markers, therefore NOT_AI. Subsequent human version bumps of still-vulnerable libxml2, and AI-unrelated 2025 dep bumps, are not used as introducers.
